build_task_scene: build a PHYRE task scene with a static bar, two jars, and two balls using the creator API
create_dynamic_object: create a dynamic jar or ball object in the PHYRE scene with a specified scale and position
set_object_position: set the position of a PHYRE scene object using set_left, set_bottom, set_center_x, or set_angle methods
get_phantom_vertices: get the phantom vertices of a PHYRE scene object for spatial relationship reasoning tasks
update_task_relationship: update the PHYRE task goal by defining a spatial relationship like INSIDE between two bodies
